create_falcon_config: create a FalconConfig instance with custom num_hidden_layers and hidden_size parameters
initialize_falcon_model: initialize a FalconModel from a FalconConfig with 2 hidden layers
access_model_config: access the model configuration from an instantiated FalconModel instance
get_head_dim: get the head dimension by dividing hidden_size by num_attention_heads
check_rotary_mode: check if rotary embeddings are enabled based on the alibi setting
